## What does this change? / 这次改了什么？

<!-- The user-visible effect and why. / 对用户可见的效果和原因。 -->

## How was it tested? / 如何验证？

- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` (UI changes / 界面改动)
- [ ] Tried it on a real Spec Kit project / 在真实的 Spec Kit 项目上试过

## Checklist / 检查项

- [ ] Tests added or updated / 已补充或更新测试
- [ ] New strings added in both English and 简体中文 / 新文案中英文都已添加
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) / 已添加 changeset
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed / 行为变化时已更新文档
